To the right of the shelves, a marble or stone-faced fireplace with a simple clean white surround is partially visible.

A long rectangular dining table in light natural oak runs through the center foreground, with six rounded-back upholstered dining chairs in a warm cream-sand fabric arranged around it. A dark cobalt blue textured ceramic vase with a dried botanical arrangement of pale seed-head stems sits as a centerpiece on the table.

The ceiling is white and flat, lit by even ambient diffuse daylight filling the space softly from off-frame windows. The floor-level and wall surfaces read in warm cream and pale wood tones throughout, a cohesive, tranquil interior.
